implementation.name: JTPRMR
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the HDL lives in the jotego/jtcores monorepo at cores/prmr/, 4 source files. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id, license_id and implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. License: https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GPLv3 text, and the per-file grant in https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/cores/prmr/hdl/jtprmr_game.v reads "either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-3.0-or-later. Machine mapping: 2 MRA files in jotego/jtbin's mra/ directory name <rbf>jtprmr</rbf>; 1 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 1 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. hdl_language_id: 4 of 4 HDL files are verilog (4 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: jotego's README claims faithfulness in prose but states no timing-fidelity level this build could check against data/lookup/accuracy_level.json. cores/prmr/cfg/files.yaml also pulls in jt539, which have no implementation record yet, so no dependency row is written for them.

implementation_dependency.note: shares HDL with the jtriders core, declared in cores/prmr/cfg/files.yaml
